scope: Local Cambridge poster and supporting project writing. Do not apply these preferences to other projects.

writing.audience: First-year undergraduates across all outputs, including reports and conversation
writing.opening: Begin with wider Earth system model development needs, then introduce portable Fortran and compiler generation. Define unfamiliar terms, symbols and units.
writing.mathematics: GitHub dollar-and-backtick inline expressions and fenced math blocks. Keep one prose paragraph or list item on each source line.
writing.title_casing: Title case for the poster title and section headings
writing.punctuation: Avoid semicolons and colons in authored prose
punctuation_exceptions: Required literal syntax, quotations, official names and bibliography metadata

identity.author: Pritthijit Nath
identity.department: Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics
identity.title: ESM.md: From Markdown Physics to Verified, Optimised Earth System Model Solvers
identity.subtitle: A framework for ESM development directly from physics formulations
identity.title_underlines: Use plain native editable title text with no underlines.

poster.logo_alignment: Align visible Cambridge and sponsor edges to the top-row margins and the conference mark to the right margin. Preserve proportions and official clear space.

banner.background: Cambridge blue gradually fading to white

workflow: c. Run/Verify with a simulation symbol and verification tick
poster.figures: Retain jet for shallow-water depth and coolwarm for temperature, with unchanged limits, units and data. Use light meshes and visible bar-value gaps.

qr.alignment: Visible black pattern aligned with the Summary top. Preserve the quiet zone.

footer.references: Vancouver with no visible URLs. Retain full identifiers in evidence.json.
footer.acknowledgements: Separate heading and full-height divider. Use the author-approved wording in README.md.
footer.conference: Bottom right, clear of reference and acknowledgement text.

poster.performance: Two CPU/GPU facets per model compare seven implementations at three grids through absolute complete-update rates, with visible cohort dates and observed twelve-run ranges. CPU axes are linear and GPU axes logarithmic.
poster.figure_unit_labels: Put units in square brackets on axes, colour bars and variable-label declarations. Keep plotted values, scales and ordinary value-unit expressions unchanged.

evidence.scope: Current esm.md measurements from November 2026 and six earlier language controls from October 2026, with separate CPU and GPU timer boundaries and twelve runs per condition.
evidence.generation: Access acknowledgements do not identify the generator. The archived generator model identifier was not recorded.

delivery: Inspect the actual final PDF and close-ups. Decode its QR at multiple render sizes. Display a PDF-rendered image in chat when requested.
version_control: Publish the complete requested poster project under paper/pasc27/poster. Keep temporary previews and build caches in local .runtime/poster_update_20261108.
